$comment: Coverage thresholds for orchestrator agents and CI. Portable across projects — adjust values per-repo. PAIRED FILE: app/.coverage-thresholds.json carries the jest-facing scope/exclusions for the same gate; threshold values in both files MUST stay identical (audit 2026-07-03).

enforcement.description: Orchestrator agents MUST check coverage against these thresholds before marking any task complete or creating a PR. If coverage drops below any threshold, the task fails.
